captions.detailed: This 3D model is a professional documentary-style camcorder colored in a matte dark gray/black finish. It features a rectangular main body with a prominent top carry handle, small control buttons on the upper surface, and a long forward-projecting lens barrel terminating in a wide rectangular lens hood. On the left side of the body, a flat viewing screen with a blue display panel is mounted on a double-hinged arm, allowing it to swing outward and pivot to face different directions.
captions.instruction: Generate an articulated 3D model of a professional video camcorder. The model should feature a rectangular main body, a top handle, a front-facing lens barrel with a wide rectangular hood, and a side-mounted viewing screen. Ensure the side screen is mounted on a double-hinged arm with revolute joints so it can rotate outward and pivot, and include a continuous rotation joint on the lens control ring.
captions.factory: The camcorder is constructed as an articulated assembly with multiple parts. The main camera body is a box primitive topped with small cylinders for buttons and a hollowed-out rectangular handle. The lens system is built from coaxial cylinders, ending in a flared rectangular hood created by lofting or extruding a draft. The side screen is a thin box with a colored screen face, connected to the body via a multi-link hinge arm. Revolute joints are modeled at the base of the hinge arm and at the screen attachment point, while a continuous joint is defined for the lens barrel's control ring.
